issue.title: Screenshot memory notes: document fix-tui-screenshots partial-success update contract (sase-169)
issue.description: Proposed by sase-169.5; routed by sase-169.land. lint_and_test.md (PNG Snapshot Tests) and tui_screenshot.md (Golden Maintenance) predate epic sase-169 and do not describe update mode's exit-0 partial status, WARNING block/skipped list, -n translation, lock waiting, or strict --check.

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by phase bead sase-169.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) and routed by the sase-169 land agent. Epic sase-169 changed the `just fix-tui-screenshots` contract (commits 7f019258b, 716291a9f, 890058e80, 4be75a3d4). The epic plan deliberately left `sase/memory/` untouched because the user did not request memory changes, and it asked for this memory bead instead.

Update two sections:

1. `lint_and_test.md`, section "PNG Snapshot Tests".
2. `tui_screenshot.md`, section "Golden Maintenance".

Both sections should state:

- Update mode (`just fix-tui-screenshots`, `just update-visual-snapshots`, and the update stage of local `just check-full`) salvages per node and per golden. When it leaves goldens untouched (unrecovered failing nodes, unstable captures, concurrent edits, or stale removal skipped on incomplete evidence), it still exits 0, with status `partial`.
- After a `partial` run, agents must read the WARNING block, or the manifest's `skipped` list and `pruning_skipped_reason`. They must not treat the skipped goldens as current, and must not read `counts:` alone as "nothing to update".
- `-n N` / `--numprocesses N` after `--` is accepted and becomes the governed `SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS` request. `-n` inside `PYTEST_ADDOPTS` is still rejected.
- A second run in the same checkout waits for the maintenance lock (bounded, default 2 hours) instead of refusing at once.
- `--check` (`just test-visual`, CI's `visual-test` job) stays strict: it never writes and exits 1 on required drift.

Source of truth: `docs/development.md` (screenshot-maintenance paragraphs), the Justfile comments above `fix-tui-screenshots`, and `_HELP_EPILOG` in `tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_maintenance_cli.py`.
